evidence.title: East Tennessee cities are gearing up to fight data centers
evidence.supports: Confirms, in an article dated 2026-07-30 (one day before researched_as_of), that Washington County's data center moratorium remains in effect through its recorded end date of 2027-06-30, with no mention of amendment, rescission, or early replacement.
evidence.quote: Washington County approved a moratorium on data centers through June 30, 2027.

decisions.notes: The recorded end date (2027-06-30) has not passed as of 2026-07-31, so the row's 'active' status is correct as recorded. Attempts to reach a primary source (the county commission's own resolution text or minutes, or the original WJHL report) were blocked: wjhl.com returned a bot-detection captcha wall on repeated fetch attempts, and washingtoncountytn.org's agendas/minutes and commission pages returned 404s during this pass. The Postindustrial/Tennessee Lookout piece is the only source actually retrieved that confirms currency as of a date close to researched_as_of; confidence is capped at moderate because it is a single secondary source, not the underlying resolution.
